subject: *: fix insert max unsigned int64 to non-clustered table (#58643)
summary: Table-scope review: only `pkg/table/tables/tables.go` changes. `AllocHandleIDs` now wraps RowID allocator failures with `errors.Trace(err)`. Checked local callers in `tables.go` and server error conversion (`pkg/server/conn.go:writeError`) uses `errors.Cause`, so wrapping should not break MySQL error-code mapping or correctness semantics on this path. The same behavior remains on `upstream/master`.
